name: Firefly Park
summary: Firefly Park is a master-planned mixed-use village in Frisco, Texas, featuring retail, office, and residential spaces set within 45 acres of natural parkland. This innovative development combines urban sophistication with world-class amenities and unparalleled natural beauty.
demographics: Firefly Park attracts affluent professionals and families in the rapidly growing Frisco, Texas market, with median household incomes exceeding $120,000. The primary trade area consists of young to middle-aged adults (30-55 years old) with high educational attainment and significant disposable income. Visitors are typically dual-income households seeking upscale retail, dining, and entertainment experiences in a mixed-use environment that combines urban sophistication with outdoor amenities.
description: Firefly Park represents a new vision for master-planned development in Frisco, Texas, seamlessly blending urban sophistication with natural beauty across 45 acres of thoughtfully designed space. This innovative mixed-use village offers a unique combination of retail, office, residential, and park amenities, creating a vibrant community destination where curiosity takes flight. Set within extensive natural parkland, Firefly Park provides world-class amenities that cater to both residents and visitors seeking an elevated lifestyle experience. The development features carefully curated retail spaces alongside modern office environments and residential options, all connected by lush green spaces and pedestrian-friendly pathways. As Frisco continues its transformation into one of North Texas's premier destinations, Firefly Park stands as a testament to forward-thinking urban planning that prioritizes both commercial vitality and environmental harmony.
